kubernetes.description: The Kubernetes manager ships with no file patterns, so it sees nothing until it is told where to look. Point it at the deployment template; without this the manifest is the one recipe Renovate cannot read.

packageRules.description: Major updates: never automerge, hold for manual approval on the dashboard.
Move the internal binary and every outer Caddy edge together.
Group Node runtime pins so .nvmrc, package engines, the Docker base image and the type definitions move together.

@types/node describes the runtime, so its major is the Node major, not a version to chase: a newer major types APIs the shipped Node does not have and the compiler stops saying anything true. Node's own major is pinned by the IDE's native-module ABI, so raise this ceiling only when that moves; a test pins the pair.
Group Rust toolchain pins so the CI toolchain and the Docker build image move together; Cargo's rust-version is pinned to them by a test.
The coverage provider is released in lockstep with the runner and refuses to load against a different minor, so move them together; a test pins the pair.
Automerge low-risk updates once CI + smoke pass.
Automerge dev dependency minor + patch once CI passes.
Group + automerge the Dockerfile build tools.
Never bump our own published image.
Patched in pnpm-workspace.yaml, where the patch filename embeds the exact version: a bump that does not also regenerate the patch fails to install. Hold for manual regeneration.
Clerk is version-locked by the overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml (@clerk/ui imports an internal hook @clerk/shared dropped after 4.14.0). Move the whole set by hand or not at all.

typescript-eslint peers `typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0`, so TS 6.1+ and the Go-native TS 7 both break typed linting. TS 7 dropped the programmatic API typescript-eslint reads types through; a replacement lands in 7.1, and typescript-eslint closed its TS 7 issue as not planned until then. Lift this when typescript-eslint's peer range names a version we want.

ESLint 10 removed the context.getFilename/getSourceCode APIs that eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y and eslint-plugin-import still call through eslint-config-next. On v10 the package aborts with a TypeError before linting a single file, so this is a hard block, not a warning. Lift when those plugins ship v10 support (jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-react#3977, vercel/next.js#89764).
Hold code-server submodule bumps for manual patch-rebase; a new release can break the quilt stack.
